messages:
pat: starting late-window slim-quant rollout now. target image=engine:slim-quant-20240402-b12. window 03:00-05:00 UTC. plan: stagger 5%->20%->60%->100%. i'll own first 40m.
nina: confirm vf_kernel patch included? that was to reduce small mem churn.
sam: yes vf_kernel is in b12. pushed image earlier. will pin before canary.
chris: rollback criteria agreed: any OOM >1 in region OR p99>250ms for >3m OR errors >1.5%. watch kv miss rate.
sam: pin command: `/deploy pin service=engine image=engine:slim-quant-20240402-b12 ttl=8h reason="late-window slim quant"`
deploy-bot: Pin created id=pin_20240402_b12 target=engine image=engine:slim-quant-20240402-b12 expires_in=8h pinned_by=sam
sre-ops: prewarmed us-east and eu-central. ap-southeast low capacity; added +3 replicas to canary.
deploy-bot: Canary started rollout_id=roll_3479999999_c1 step=5% watch=6m auto-fallback=true
pat: 5% canary out, initial telemetry looks fine.
(6m)
sre-ops: at 20% we observed 2 OOMs in ap-southeast pods; node logs show `cuda_alloc_failure`. kube restarted them, no client errors yet.
chris: triggers OOM rule. recommend partial rollback for ap-southeast and pause global progression.
sam: executing partial rollback ap-southeast -> engine:previous.
deploy-bot: Partial rollback executed: region=ap-southeast from engine:slim-quant-20240402-b12 -> engine:previous. Global rollout paused.
pat: holding at 20% for 15m to observe.
sre-ops: running a focused soak in eu-central with QUANT_REORDER=0 to see if kernel reordering is involved.
(12m)
sre-ops: soak clear, no OOMs. suggests interaction between reorder and ap-southeast driver combo.
chris: decision: cut patched image b12a (reorder disabled + shim) and test in ap-southeast. extend pin TTL so we can debug.
sam: `/deploy pin extend id=pin_20240402_b12 add_ttl=4h reason="patch testing"`
deploy-bot: Pin extended id=pin_20240402_b12 new_ttl=12h extended_by=sam
sam: b12a built and smoke ok. starting ap-southeast canary 5% for b12a.
deploy-bot: Canary region rollout region=ap-southeast rollout_id=roll_3479999999_apc1 step=5% watch=8m image=engine:slim-quant-20240402-b12a
sre-ops: 8m check clear, memory stable. advancing to 20% in ap-southeast.
deploy-bot: Resuming global rollout. final: 100% -> engine:slim-quant-20240402-b12a. Summary: OOMs=2 (ap-southeast rolled back), peak_p95_diff=+11%, errors_peak=0.7%. Pin retained expires_in=12h.
pat: action items: file RCA for driver+reorder, add ap-southeast shim to packaging, update model-catalog note. Posting follow-up in eng-release. Good catch team. :white_check_mark:
